name: SoMe
one_liner: AI-native social and dating platform that bridges matching to real-world dates

team.ceo_background: Co-founder and CEO with an MBA in Marketing and experience as a serial e-commerce and restaurant entrepreneur
team.core_team: Xi Jiang is co-founder and CTO from UChicago CS, and Xuhan Xie is co-founder and engineer with prior TikTok backend scale experience

product_highlights: AI Date Concierge for intent-based matching and planning
End-to-end date workflow including venue booking and payments
Dual-sided marketplace connecting dating users with local businesses
market: Addresses the large dating-app market by reducing friction between matches and real-world meetings.
current_progress: Full product prototype with partner merchant network of 13+ local and chain businesses.
